title: Paul McCartney live: Gund Arena, Cleveland | 2002
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Gund Arena in Cleveland, Ohio, USA, on 29 April 2002.

It was the 16th date of the Driving World Tour, which lasted for 58 dates across four countries between April and November 2002.

This show was seen by 17,564 fans. The Driving World Tour returned to the Gund Arena on 4 October 2002.

The performance of ‘All My Loving’ from this show appears on the 2002 live albums Back In The US and Back In The World.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

McCartney returned to the Quicken Loans Arena, as the Gund Arena was later renamed, on 17 and 18 August 2016 during the One On One Tour.
